The query returned **16,197 records** with the Entrez date bound of 2017-12-14 and no publication-date limit. It retrieved all **8/8 benchmark records** and **9/9 records found relevant during development**. Those figures are relative recall against the identified sets, not sensitivity; there was no held-out validation set.

The count exceeds the 10,000-record workload budget. The population block was tested but left out because it reduced results by only 12%; the setting and outcome blocks were retained after substantial reductions and 30-record loss samples with no eligible records. These samples do not rule out missed studies. The audit also records that the PRESS-structured internal critique was same-context; independent PRESS peer review is pending.
